verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents a local terminal agent that edits files, compiles, runs tests and presents a diff for review, plus a headless `exec` mode for CI. Nothing in the evidence shows a vendor-hosted cloud agent that runs a task remotely, and nothing shows it producing a demo of the feature. Running `exec` inside a user's own CI pipeline is a user-side arrangement, so the product does not itself deliver the cloud build-test-demo workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
